candidate_definition.rule: EMA50 trigger plus every declared hard gate, before the scored-conditions minimum

EMA50 trigger plus every declared hard gate, before the scored-conditions minimum; one decision on the first examined closed bar that qualifies for each distinct cross. The scanner counts consecutive closes strictly above EMA50 (candles_above, 1 through 4); the cross candle is current position - candles_above + 1. Later qualifying bars with that asset and cross candle share one event id and are not re-asked. A close at or below EMA50 ends the run; a subsequent cross is a new event.
